contract.intent: Use one end-to-end measurement boundary for baseline and harness comparisons and diagnose real regressions.

outcomes.statement: Baseline samples record end-to-end elapsed time while retaining provider-only timing for diagnosis.
The refreshed manifest contains three independent, schema-valid baseline samples per task.
The benchmark report compares only complete baseline medians with harness medians and keeps incomplete-baseline duration claims unavailable.
The common end-to-end measurement boundary and its limitations are documented.

checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('benchmarks/agentskit-os-phase-28.json')); const ok=m.observations.length===3 && m.observations.every(o=>o.durationSamplesMs?.length===3 && o.durationMs===[...o.durationSamplesMs].sort((a,b)=>a-b)[1] && o.source.startsWith('benchmarks/agentskit-os-phase-36-baseline/')); if(!ok) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['replicated-data'],taskCount:m.observations.length,samplesPerTask:3}))"

pnpm --filter @agentskit/harness build && pnpm --filter @agentskit/harness test:metrics && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['scripts/run-agentskit-os-harness-benchmark.mjs','--collect','--repeats','3','--phase-root','.codex/verification/phase-33/benchmark'],{encoding:'utf8'}); const x=JSON.parse(r.stdout.trim().split(/\r?\n/).at(-1)); const ok=x.report.qualityGate.status==='insufficient-data' && x.report.comparisons.every(c=>c.comparability==='baseline-incomplete' && c.improvement.duration==='unavailable'); if(!ok) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['comparison-integrity'],qualityGate:x.report.qualityGate.status}))"
node scripts/verify-harness-package.mjs && pnpm check:doc-bridge-config && pnpm check:readme-standard && node -e "console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['docs']}))"
